name: Konsui
source:
When everyday life turns strange, and the world you know becomes a mystery, what will it take to finally wake up?

Etsuko likes to enjoy the simple things in life such as talking to friends, spending time in nature, and meeting new people. Though her life has been seemingly normal for as long as she can remember, she will soon uncover a past which she couldn't remember.

[From [url=https://mekajikitan08.itch.io/konsui]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当日常生活变得陌生，你所熟悉的世界变得神秘，要怎样才能最终醒来？

悦子喜欢享受生活中的简单事情，例如与朋友交谈、在大自然中度过时光以及结识新朋友。虽然从她记事起她的生活似乎很正常，但她很快就会发现一段她不记得的过去。

[来自[url=https://mekajikitan08.itch.io/konsui]Itch.io[/url]]
